cues: Step four: marriage is a form of capital, as surely as any other resource.
Nock borrows three kinds from the sociologist James Coleman.
Physical capital: tools, buildings, money, wholly tangible.
Human capital: the skills and knowledge in a person, less tangible.
And social capital: found in the relations among persons, less tangible yet.
It is a network of people linked by trust that obligations will be incurred and repaid.
